action: Starts from a DynaMesh sphere at low resolution; polygroup patches already mark the face area (lighter front shield, top band).
why: Cheap, remeshable start; polygroups split face vs skull regions.
reader_equivalent: UV sphere + Voxel Remesh (large voxel size); Face Sets for regions.

action: Head cut into hard planar facets: flat front face plane, flat cheek/side planes, a narrow lighter strip down the middle for the brow-nose plane, flat jaw underside.
tool: planar cuts (TrimCurve/ClipCurve on shelf; exact tool inferred)
why: Establish the big planes of the anime head (front, side, jaw) before any features.
reader_equivalent: Bisect / Line Project (sculpt Trim/Line Project tools) or Flatten/Scrape with plane lock, then Voxel Remesh.

action: At higher resolution the head is still faceted but now has a pointed nose wedge, eye sockets, mouth line and an ear; he details the ear and the brow/eye area in profile.
tool: DynaMesh remesh up + sculpt brush (brush size readout 102.546)
why: Raise resolution only after planes are right; keep planes while adding features.
reader_equivalent: Voxel Remesh with smaller voxel size; Clay Strips / Crease for features.

action: Draws the anime eye on a smooth face: large eye with incised concentric iris rings, sharp upper lash-line ridge, thin raised brow, small pointed nose, thin incised mouth line.
tool: fine sculpt brush on pen display
why: Anime eyes as carved graphic lines on a near-flat eye area rather than a round eyeball.
reader_equivalent: Crease/Draw Sharp with small radius for lash line and iris rings; Layer brush for the raised brow.

action: Isolates a band around the eyes (rest hidden), polygrouped in colours, with closed lids; then on the full head a curve line is drawn around the head at eye level marking the blindfold band.
tool: hide/show by polygroup, curve stroke (curve brush type not readable)
why: Define the blindfold strip from the head surface so it fits the skull (inferred).
reader_equivalent: Mask the band (Mask brush / Face Set), Mask > Extract (or Duplicate + Solidify + Shrinkwrap) to make the blindfold.

action: Hair is many separate pointed flat locks, each with a crisp central ridge, standing up from above the blindfold; he moves a lock group with the Gizmo.
tool: Gizmo 3D move on separate lock geometry
why: Spiky locks placed and angled individually for silhouette; low poly keeps them editable.
reader_equivalent: Separate lock objects or Face Sets; G/R/S with pivot, or sculpt Pose/Grab with masks.

action: Shapes the fingers of a long hand, then poses the hand against the face (two fingers over the blindfold) with the Gizmo/transpose.
why: Fit the pose of the hand to the face for the iconic gesture.
reader_equivalent: Pose brush or Mask + Rotate around a joint pivot.

action: Full body in clothes: jacket and trousers are low-poly faceted shells over a sculpted body; he rotates/scales one trouser leg with the Gizmo to adjust the pose.
why: Block clothes as simple shells first and fix pose/proportion before cloth detail.
reader_equivalent: Low-poly clothing mesh (Edit Mode or Solidify + Shrinkwrap), G/R/S with pivot on the leg.

action: Detailed back anatomy under the clothes: scapulae, spine groove, lats and erectors clearly sculpted with stroke streaks.
why: Anatomy underneath makes the clothes and pose believable.
reader_equivalent: Clay Strips for muscle masses, Crease for the spine groove, Smooth.

action: Final: blindfold has wrinkled cloth folds, high collar is a thick rolled band, hand covers the face, nose is a small soft point and the smile a single curved line with corner dimples.
why: Finished head read: graphic minimal features plus detailed cloth.
reader_equivalent: Cloth/Clay Strips for blindfold folds, Crease for mouth line.
